fact: The NCSI version of 4 September 2026 credits Guinea with a valid national cybersecurity strategy 2022-2027 with action plan (3/3 each) and records ANSSI under Decree D/266/PRG/SGG/2016 as the national threat-assessment entity, while scoring national CERT, incident-reporting obligations and CII identification at 0.
title: NCSI :: Guinea
